utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is really coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can ask around and let you know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Tess — please do, and I’ll send the repair drive details over right now so everyone has everything in one place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and share the time and place as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Head to the community center entrance. I’ll bring the fragile stuff there and label it too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — that sounds perfect. I’ll meet you at the community center entrance and keep an eye out for anything else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll be there soon with the fragile items labeled.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands now, and I’ll check back in on the repair drive once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that confirmed yet? What time does the repair drive start, and who’s bringing the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure it’s confirmed yet — I’ll check in when I’m back and see what time the repair drive starts and who’s bringing the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive—what time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d help a lot. I’m thinking late afternoon after pickup, maybe 4 to 6 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 to 6 should work for me, since that’s after pickup. I can help coordinate around then and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll bring a drill and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — do we know what time the repair drive starts yet? I still want to confirm the timing before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard the start time yet, but I can check in and confirm it for us.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik — I’m still keeping an ear out about the repair drive. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know as soon as the time and place are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll keep listening too, and I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help sort things once the list is ready. Just tell me what’s still short, and I’ll see what I can spare quietly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—once the list is ready, tell me what’s still short and I’ll bring what I can. I’ll keep an eye out for the time and place too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m on it. Once the list comes through, I’ll check what’s still short and bring what I can quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Gus — I’ll check Rosa’s setup note and send you the details on the small repairs soon. If you hear of anyone handy, I’d really appreciate the extra help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for anyone handy, and send over whatever tools I can spare once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — could you send the repair drive details first? I want to double-check everything before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I can send the repair drive details first so you can double-check them. Sorry if I missed anything earlier.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please send the repair drive details, and I’ll check them carefully before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a rough count of supplies for the repair drive, but I haven’t sorted everything yet. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll spread the word and keep it simple for now. If anything else comes up, I’ll help line up a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. Keep me posted, and I’ll keep checking what supplies I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good start. I can help match people with the right supplies, and I’d be glad to lend a hand on the smaller fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m headed to the community center now for the repair drive. Thanks for helping with the supplies and the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m glad to help. Let me know if you need anything once you get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help a little, just quietly, and I’ll watch for your note.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. I’ll send out the note with the Sunday time and where to meet at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, Rosa — I’ll look for the note and be there quietly on Sunday. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I still need the timing and supply details first. Do we know who’s bringing what and when the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send over the timing and supply details now so you have everything in one place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — that really helps. Once I have the details, I can figure out the logistics and make sure everything gets there on time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What kind of repairs are you hoping to get organized?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to spread the word once the time and place are locked in, and I’ll make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Vik. Once you’ve got the time and place set, let me know and I can help match people with supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — could you send the repair drive details first? I want to double-check everything before I help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details over right away so you can double-check everything. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll take a look as soon as they’re over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, for sure — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if the time or place gets set. I can also check whether they still need anything beyond batteries, extension cords, and heavy-duty tape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send the final time and place when you have it. Those supplies sound right, and the community center entrance is still the spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass along the final time and place as soon as I hear it. Glad the community center entrance is still the spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Gus, can I swing by now to pick up the drill and screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — swing by anytime and I’ll have the drill and screwdrivers ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’m on my way now. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s confirmed for Sunday at the community center. I’m still sorting the supply list, and I’ll share the start time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the community center for the repair drive and wait for the start time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll send the start time and supply details as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and help quietly where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sounds good — I’ll check back in once I’m back and see how the repair drive’s going.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate it — I’ll keep it quiet and do what I can when you check back in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Then we can line up the timing and supplies together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll check back in once I’m done running errands and let you know how the repair drive is going.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Ira — I’ll get the word out and have a few neighbors ready to help. Just check back in when you’re set, and we’ll line up the timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Sam — I’m happy to help with the repair drive, but I’m a bit forgetful, so just remind me of the time and place and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — we’re meeting at the community center at 10am on Saturday, and if you can bring a drill and some spare screws, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — community center at 10am on Saturday. I’ll bring a drill and some spare screws and be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of work gloves. If you can help sort, I’ll check what’s left and set aside the extras.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can sort that out and help keep it organized around pickup time. I’ll check what’s left and set aside the extras.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll check what’s left on my end and set aside any extras for pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that confirmed yet—what time does the repair drive start, and who’s bringing the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not confirmed yet, but I’m checking on it now. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the time and supply list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please let me know as soon as it’s confirmed. I still need the start time and the supply list before I can help.
